thread:
anya (product): Quick check-in: we need a consistent client-visible contract for graceful degradations and a single set of telemetry tags for the console. Can we agree on the minimal surface?

sam (eng-platform): We should keep the API surface tiny: HTTP 200 for graceful degrade, add route metadata, and an opt-in verbose warning. Avoid new status codes.

tess (eng-runtime): runtime emits internal ROUTE_OVERFLOW/ROUTE_COMPAT. Proposal: map to public values 'degraded' and 'compat'. Add metadata.route = 'degraded' and metadata.variant = 'compat-v1' (variant names are opaque to users).

omar (eng-platform): devex asks we not leak raw model names. Use short variant tags: compat, cached, realtime. Good to have an allowlist per org.

lee (devex): console: show a small pill on route details: "Degraded (compat)" with a tooltip: "A small % of requests used a compatibility variant to meet latency/SLOs." Link to runbook. Don't auto-banner for <1% rate.

nav (eng-sre): telemetry: tag traces with rw.route_kind and rw.variant. Emit metrics: rw.fallback.count, rw.fallback.rate (percent), rw.fallback.latency_ms.p95. Alerting thresholds: warn at 3% sustained 4h, escalate at 15% sustained 12h.

sam (eng-platform): API contract sketch: headers: `X-RW-Route: degraded|primary|cached` body snippet: "\"route\":{\"kind\":\"degraded\",\"variant\":\"compat\"}" verbose flag per-request `?verbose_route=true` returns `warning` field.

tess (eng-runtime): implementation detail: add config per-customer `expose_route_tag: none|variants|full`. Hosted defaults to variants only. Dedicated can opt into full (hashed ids).

anya (product): wording for docs/console: prefer "served from compatibility variant to preserve latency" vs words like "fallback". Keep tone reassuring.

omar (eng-platform): rollout plan: internal canary -> alpha opt-in customers -> GA. Console surfaces + metrics must be live before alpha.

lee (devex): dashboard panels: 1) per-route fallback % 2) top variants 3) sampled degraded responses (secure bucket). Default timeframe: 1w.

nav (eng-sre): add nightly job to sample degraded responses and run auto-evals. If quality drop > threshold and fallback_rate > X open incident.

sam (eng-platform): small decision: HTTP 200 + metadata vs 2xx with warning header. Vote 200.

anya (product): consensus: 200 + minimal metadata + optional verbose warning. I'll draft helptext and runbook copy.

all: +1

kb-bot (deploy-bot): runtime tagging rollout completed in eu-central-1.
